newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAAB Auto U.S. car sales up 70 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: SAAB Auto U.S. car sales up 70 pct in Dec.

text.p: Swedish-U.S. vehicle maker SAAB Automobile AB said on Friday that U.S. sales rose 70 percent in December, giving a 1996 rise of 11 percent.
Saab Automobile said in a statement that car sales in December rose to 2,509 compared to 1,480 a year earlier.
This brought U.S. sales for the full year to 28,440 cars which was 2,845 cars more than in 1995. In 1996, Saab thereby posted its strongest U.S. sales since 1989.
The Saab 900 sold wider in 1996 with a total of 22,400 cars sold with the five door model the most popular.
Sales of the Saab 900 Cabriolet increased by nearly 500 cars to 6,700. Sales of the Saab 9000 were largely unchanged at around 6,000 cars.
